title: Release notes JSON
prompt:
Produce release notes for version 2.4.1 of a notes app. Highlight faster search and offline editing. Fix a crash when renaming a folder.

Return one JSON object and nothing else. It must include:
- "version": a semantic version string
- "highlights": an array of strings
- "fixes": an array of strings

Do not include TODO or FIXME.
constraints: version is a dotted semantic version
